exercises.instruction: Write sentences about yourself. Imagine things you would like or wouldn't like.

items.prompt: (a job you wouldn't like to do)
modelAnswers: I wouldn't like to be a teacher.
I'd love to learn to fly a plane.

items.prompt: (something that would be nice to have)
modelAnswers: It would be nice to have a big garden.

items.prompt: (a place you'd like to go to)
modelAnswers: I'd like to go to Mexico.
